name: Default No-Feints Support
dsl: ?(deck.remaining >= 2) sharp @ spell(any<blade>) & sharp @ spell(any<blade>) & potent @ spell(any<trap & !feint>) & potent @ spell(any<trap & !feint>) | ?(self.health < 30%) any<heal> @ self | ?(ally(last).health < 30% && ally(last).is_dead == 0) any<heal> @ ally(last) | ?(ally(last).is_dead == 1) any<damage & aoe>[any<mod_damage>] | ?(ally(last).is_dead == 1) any<damage>[any<mod_damage>] @ enemy | any<blade & stacks>[sharp] @ ally(last) | any<trap & aoe & !feint & stacks> | any<trap & !aoe & !feint & stacks>[potent] @ boss | any<blade>[sharp] @ ally(last) | any<trap & aoe & !feint> | any<trap & !aoe & !feint>[potent] @ boss | any<global> | pass
description: Support for a boss that cheats when a Feint is cast; it never casts or enchants one. Below 30% health it heals itself, then P1. Otherwise a blade on P1, a mass trap and a trap on the boss, each that stacks before the same ones that don't, then a global, and it passes rather than spend P1's buffs. Once P1 is dead, it attacks.
